title: 'Mayonaka Heart Tune 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Masakuni Igarashi 's Mayonaka Heart Tune ( Tune In to the Midnight Heart ) manga revealed an additional cast pair and a second teaser visual (pictured) for the second season on Saturday. The new season will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Anime's 2nd Season Reveals More Cast, 2027 Debut
content: NBC Universal revealed on Saturday the second season of the television anime of Masakuni Igarashi 's Tune In to the Midnight Heart ( Mayonaka Heart Tune ) manga will debut in 2027. NBC Universal also confirmed the mostly returning staff, and revealed more cast and a visual.

title: Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya’s Upcoming Film Will Reveal New Information on July 20
content: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya ‘s X account has announced that it will reveal new information about the franchise’s new film on July 20 at 6:00 PM (JST). The upcoming film will be a sequel to Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya – Licht Nameless Girl.
